name: Current fractional policy on October completed sessions
hypothesis: Determine whether the current $500 fractional-market paper policy produces reproducible entries and exits over a longer sampled-quote window; measure costs, blocked entries, open positions and observed drawdown without selecting parameters or claiming profitability.
universe_selection: Two current nominees, selected for an execution demonstration: CRWD is already held in forward paper; DDOG is another nominee. This is retrospective selection, not a holdout or reconstructed historical watchlist.
date_boundary: All 17 completed sessions covered by the reviewed October-December cost schedule; do not extrapolate that schedule into September.
settings: Freeze current applied signal execution and allocation settings, rule/parameter/profile versions and source hashes. No overrides, funding change, parameter search or forced terminal exit.
data: Alpaca historical SIP regular-hours quotes, five-minute samples and a terminal bid mark; raw daily profile history, verified session calendar and observed corporate-action coverage. Stop on incomplete acquisition or unsupported actions.
success_criterion: Complete consecutive acquisition, deterministic replay and independent exact cash/share/fee/P&L reconstruction. Report zero trades or unknown marks as recorded; do not weaken gates to create activity.
limits: Historical earnings, listing/classification and per-symbol fractional permission are research assumptions; quote sampling does not reproduce continuous order books or historical arrival latency. No strategy edge or forward-paper acceptance is established.
execution_boundary: Local research artifacts only; no deployment, runtime configuration, forward-paper ledger, broker order or watchlist mutation. Existing forward paper scheduling remains enabled.
